info.title: Scripture Habit API
info.description: Scripture Habit internal backend APIs for User Profiles, Group Chat, AI Translation & Weekly Recaps, 1-Min Sandbox Demo, Cron Jobs, Safety Reporting, and Link Previews. Making daily scripture study more fun and meaningful.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase ID Token in Authorization header: Bearer <token>

cronSecret.description: Cron Secret in Authorization header: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>

post.description: Initializes a new user profile document upon initial sign-up.
Updates nickname, photoURL, stake/ward, bio, language, or tutorial flags, and syncs changes to chats.
Verifies that the user's email is verified and prevents disallowed test accounts in production.

403.description: Email not verified or forbidden domain

post.description: Completely deletes user account, exits groups, purges reactions, and recursively removes private data.

200.description: Account and all data deleted successfully

message.example: Account and all data deleted successfully.

get.description: Retrieves public groups with member previews and latest activity for joining. Auto-seeds demo group for demo users.

post.description: Creates a new habit study group (Owner receives owner permissions). Enforces group limits.

400.description: Group limit reached or invalid input

post.description: Creates a dedicated 1-on-1 habit group with Scripture Habit AI Companion.
Adds current user to a private group using an invite code.

400.description: Group is full or already joined

404.description: Group or Invite Code not found

post.description: Removes current user from the specified group and safely transfers ownership if owner leaves.
Saves daily study note, calculates consecutive streaks, updates unity scores across member groups, and syncs note to chat.

comment.example: 信仰を持って前進することの大切さを学びました。

post.description: Posts a chat message or reply to a group. Broadcasts push notifications to group members.

text.example: 今日も学びがありました！

post.description: Generates a fresh 6-character alphanumeric invite code for a group (Owner only).

get.summary: Get Firestore Bundle for Group Messages
get.description: Fetches pre-packaged binary Firestore Bundle containing recent group messages for fast single-Read initial load.

post.description: Asynchronously translates text or user nicknames using Gemini AI with caching.

text.example: こんにちは！一緒に聖句を読みましょう。

post.description: Translates multiple chat messages in a single batch request for efficiency.

text.example: ニーファイ第一部3章を読みました。

post.description: Generates AI-powered weekly study recap and reflection encouragement based on recent study notes.

recapText.example: 今週はニーファイの信仰について素晴らしい学びがありましたね！

post.description: Initializes an isolated, simulated 999-day streak environment with bot group members for instant browser demos.
Submits a safety report to Firestore and alerts moderation via Discord Webhook.

get.description: Fetches OGP metadata for official Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints article links with SSRF protection.

description.example: Nephi and his brothers return to Jerusalem...

400.description: Invalid URL or blocked non-allowed domain

post.description: Scans users nearing streak expiration and dispatches FCM push notifications.

all.description: Evaluates member inactivity thresholds and automatically removes inactive members if threshold is breached.

post.description: Resets the daily unity percentage for a group if midnight in the group's time zone has passed.
Updates the lastReadMessageId and lastReadAt timestamp for the current user in a group.
Broadcasts a 100% daily unity achievement announcement to the group chat.

400.description: Unity is not 100% or already announced today

post.description: Removes a member from the group (Owner only).
Configures personal habit pace (autokick threshold between 3 and 7 days).
Permanently deletes a study group and cleans up all member states (Owner only).
Updates group name, description, or visibility (Owner only).

get.summary: Get Group Preview by Invite Code
get.description: Retrieves public group details and active member preview cards for invite link landing pages.

404.description: Invite code not found or expired

post.description: Adds or removes an emoji reaction to a chat message.
Deletes a personal study note and propagates deletion to shared group message copies.
Edits the text of an existing chat message (Sender only).

text.example: 修正後のメッセージです。

post.description: Deletes a chat message from the group chat (Sender or Group Owner).
Sends an encouragement cheer push notification to a group member who hasn't posted today.

400.description: Already cheered today or member already posted

post.description: Generates 3 deep study reflection questions for a scripture chapter using Gemini AI.

example: 主が命じられたことを行うとき、どのような勇気が湧きますか？

get.description: Fetches standard OGP metadata (title, description, image) for arbitrary web links with SSRF protection.

post.description: Submits feedback, bug reports, or feature ideas to Firestore with optional Discord Webhook notification.

message.example: ダークモードのコントラストをもう少し高くしてほしいです！

get.description: Performs a read-only dry run inactivity diagnostic on a group without making database modifications.

all.description: Syncs totalNotes, cheersReceived, and membership integrity against physical Firestore database truth for active users.
Identifies and purges orphaned cheers whose target user or group has been deleted.

all.summary: Post Daily Study Notes for AI Partner Groups
all.description: Automatically generates daily study notes via Gemini for AI Partner Groups and reconciles chat cache.
Recursively purges anonymous demo accounts and groups older than 1 hour (DEMO_TTL_MS).
Retrieves daily active user counts for the past N days.
